description: Ensemble of 250 trees with regularization; optimal trade-off on imbalanced credit default data.
High stability on non-linear behavior; slightly conservative on early borderline defaults.
Traditional scorecard regulator-audited linear model; highly interpretable odds ratios.
Fast tree boosting with depth-constrained split criteria and L1 sparsity penalty.
Dense neural network with Dropout (0.2); capture complex interaction effects, requires higher compute.
Hard-coded threshold rules (utilization > 80% or delinquency >= 2) without statistical weighting.
